title: 12 AI automation examples (and how teams built them)
summary: AI needs to be integrated with your workflows to have an impact. Here are 12 examples of AI automation used across different teams—and how they were built.
body_markdown: Build automations from wherever you work. Describe the outcome you want, and Zapier connects your tools, runs the steps, and stays on the job after you close the chat.
